svg.title: Orbiter 8 intro mockup: waking in your ship over Earth, with Minerva’s first message (desktop)
svg.text: You’re awake. This is your ship, the Second Chance, in orbit over
Earth. Your body is in storage. Your mind is here, with me. You
owe the pilot program 45 credits. The hold carries the program’s
advance: Helium-3 and Electronics. Sell them at the I.S.S., clear
the debt, then go find a star nobody has. That’s the job.
Processing is a fade through white; the ship fades in
already in orbit, engines quiet. The HUD arrives piece by
piece after the message (not shown). Your ship is white
like every ship; yellow marks it as yours.
